I've been farming this land for 40 years. I know what works here in Quzhou. My back is not what it was, and three of my children work in the city now, so I need to be careful with labor. But I still have my wife and two others who help during busy periods. The well is reliable, so water is not my worry — electricity cost is.

**How I think about my land:**

My 13.1 mu breaks into three sections in my head. The main block — about 10.1 mu — I plant wheat every October and then decide after harvest: 8 mu goes to maize because the price is steady and the combine comes to our village. The remaining 2.1 mu I put to mungbean after wheat. Mungbean is easy — I can do it myself, and the buyers come to the village gate in August. The other 3 mu sits separate — I've grown cotton there for 25 years. Cotton is hard work but the county still has a ginning station and the price last year was acceptable.

**Wheat:** I buy 济麦22 or whatever the seed station recommends that is similar — improved, not traditional. I apply compound fertilizer at sowing and urea at jointing. I irrigate before winter sets, again at jointing, again at heading — three times is usually enough with our rains. I spray herbicide in winter and one fungicide near heading for rust.

**Maize:** I use Zhengdan 958 hybrid seed. I plant directly into the wheat stubble without deep tillage — saves diesel and time. Two or three irrigations. One spray for armyworm if they show up, which they usually do now.

**Cotton:** This is my most demanding crop. I start seedlings in April under plastic film. Cotton needs the most fertilizer and the most spraying — bollworm, aphids, spider mites. I spray five or six times across the season. I still pick by hand which takes weeks. My wife and I do it together.

**Mungbean:** Minimal inputs. It fixes some nitrogen. I broadcast some compound fertilizer at planting, water once or twice, and spray once if aphids get bad. I harvest before the pods shatter — timing matters.

I do not experiment much at my age. I apply what I know works. My yields are not the county maximum but they are reliable.
